options.content: Pilots: **Live now** · Traffic · New pilots · Origins · Records · Routes · Aircraft · Military | ATC: Overview · Retention · Hours · Positions · Ranks | Events: Live events · Monday events | Management: Health All times are UTC. Figures cover VATPAC airspace.

panels.title: Pilots in the region now
panels.description: Pilots connected inside the VATPAC region in the latest network snapshot (v1 card 68, How many pilots online?). The arrow is the change compared with one hour ago.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS time, pilots_in_region AS "Pilots in the region"
FROM network_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pilots on the whole network now
panels.description: Pilots connected anywhere on VATSIM in the latest network snapshot (no v1 card; context for the regional figure). The arrow is the change compared with one hour ago.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS time, pilots_global AS "Pilots on the network"
FROM network_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Region share of the network
panels.description: Pilots in the region as a percentage of pilots on the whole network, latest network snapshot (no v1 card). There is no change arrow: a percentage change of a percentage would be easy to misread.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS time, 100.0 * pilots_in_region / NULLIF(pilots_global, 0) AS "Region share"
FROM network_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pilots online over the last 24 hours
panels.description: Pilots online in each time bucket over the last 24 hours, UTC. Whole network on the left axis; the region on the right axis because its numbers are much smaller, so read the two scales separately. The table shows the latest, highest, lowest and average value. Same query as before the redesign (no v1 card).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(observed_at, $__interval),
       avg(pilots_in_region) AS "In region",
       avg(pilots_global) AS "Network-wide"
FROM network_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pilots online over the last 7 days
panels.description: The same chart over the last 7 days, UTC, so the weekday and weekend rhythm shows. Whole network on the left axis, the region on the right axis. Same query as the 24-hour chart (no v1 card).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(observed_at, $__interval),
       avg(pilots_in_region) AS "In region",
       avg(pilots_global) AS "Network-wide"
FROM network_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: When are people online on weekdays (last 30 days)
panels.description: Callsigns online in each UTC hour on weekdays over the last 30 days, regardless of the time selector. Pilots only here; the ATC series is in its own panel below. Counts each distinct callsign online in that UTC hour, not an average (v1 card 94).

targets.rawSql:
-- v1 card 94: callsigns online in each UTC clock hour over the last 30 days.
WITH flight_hours AS (
    SELECT f.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int >= EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int + 24 END
           ) % 24 AS active_hour
    FROM flight f
    WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
      AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') BETWEEN 1 AND 5
      AND f.logon_time IS NOT NULL
      AND f.end_time IS NOT NULL
),
atc_hours AS (
    SELECT cs.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int >= EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int + 24 END
           ) % 24 AS active_hour
    FROM controller_summaries cs
    WHERE (cs.session_start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
           OR cs.session_end_time >= now() - interval '30 days')
      AND cs.session_duration_minutes >= 20
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') BETWEEN 1 AND 5
      AND cs.session_start_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(fh.active_hour, ah.active_hour)::int AS hour_utc,
       COALESCE(fh.n, 0) AS "Pilots (callsigns)",
       COALESCE(ah.n, 0) AS "ATC (callsigns)"
FROM (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM flight_hours GROUP BY active_hour) fh
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM atc_hours GROUP BY active_hour) ah
  ON fh.active_hour = ah.active_hour
ORDER BY 1
